Without it (Mode Report) the run is read-only: dsregcmd /status facts, the client-side SCP values in HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\CDJ\AAD, the Automatic-Device-Join task and AD domain reachability. {"Mode":"Join","TenantId":"00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000","TenantName":"contoso.onmicrosoft.com"} (base64 eyJNb2RlIjoiSm9pbiIsIlRlbmFudElkIjoiMDAwMDAwMDAtMDAwMC0wMDAwLTAwMDAtMDAwMDAwMDAwMDAwIiwiVGVuYW50TmFtZSI6ImNvbnRvc28ub25taWNyb3NvZnQuY29tIn0=) writes TenantId and TenantName there after a backup to C:\ProgramData\Relian\hybrid-join\, reads them back, then starts the join task and reports again. Mode Scp writes the values only. TenantId must be a GUID and TenantName a domain name; there are no defaults. Refuses a device that is not domain-joined; an AzureAdJoined device is reported and left alone. Rollback: restore the backed-up values, or delete the CDJ\AAD key when the backup says keyExists false. Never runs dsregcmd /leave.
